title: Micaiah Tells the Truth
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who is brave in small, true ways, and tonight Micaiah tells a king the truth when four hundred voices say otherwise: Beau owns up to a broken lamp when it would be easier to blame the cat.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because Beau is brave in small, true ways, and Micaiah was brave enough to tell a king the truth. In Beau’s world today: a ball bounces off the wall indoors and Mom’s lamp crashes down. His brother whispers, “Let’s say the cat did it.” Beau’s tummy flips. He stands up tall, finds Mom, and tells her what really happened. Just like Micaiah, Beau learned that telling the truth takes courage, and Heavenly Father is happy when we are honest.
